response.sql: WITH district_counts AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account GROUP BY district_id), district_shares AS (SELECT district_id, account_count, CAST(account_count AS REAL) / SUM(account_count) OVER () AS share FROM district_counts) SELECT district_id, account_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average_share FROM district_shares ORDER BY above_average_share DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 10;
